accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only: attestation no longer changes the lifecycle. `settle` does
that, after the veto window.

accounts.name: sooth_log_program
docs: Durable-log sink. Receives the batched `OrdersFilled` payload as an
inner instruction; see the `sooth_log` crate for why a second program
is unavoidable. Address-pinned — the program is permissionless, so
authenticity is a consumer-side check, not an on-chain one.

accounts.name: amm_state
docs: AMM state for this market. Must be dismissed.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority signer-only PDA.

accounts.name: position
docs: AMM Position account — closed by the inline `close_dismissed_position`.

accounts.name: lock_entry
docs: Lock entry to drain + close. Anchor's `close = user` refunds the
rent lamports to `user` and zeroes the discriminator on success.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global protocol config. Checked for `paused` flag.

accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only: a veto changes the outcome, not the lifecycle.

accounts.name: fee_pool_authority
docs: account.

accounts.name: adjudicator_entry
docs: Per-market adjudicator record. Bound to `market` via seed derivation.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority that may request a lock. Must be `adjudicator_entry.authority`.

accounts.name: recipient_usdc_ata
docs: USDC destination ATA — may be owned by any authority.

accounts.name: source_yes_ata
docs: Token account holding YES shares — burned from; authority = `source_authority`.

accounts.name: source_no_ata
docs: Token account holding NO shares — burned from; authority = `source_authority`.

accounts.name: source_authority
docs: Authority over the source token accounts.

accounts.name: adjudicator_entry
docs: New per-market `AdjudicatorEntry` PDA.

accounts.name: position
docs: Per-(user, market) Position. Must already exist — you can only
sell shares you've previously bought.

accounts.name: lock_entry
docs: New `LockEntry` PDA. Seeds `[b"lock_entry", position.key(), lock_nonce.to_le_bytes()]`.
The `lock_nonce` instruction parameter must equal `position.lock_nonce`.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Finalize an attested market. Permissionless once the veto window has
closed; the outcome comes from the `AdjudicatorEntry`, not the caller.

accounts.name: adjudicator_entry
docs: Per-market adjudicator record. Used to authenticate the caller.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever cranks the settle. Unconstrained by design — see module docs.
Present only so the transaction has a signer to pay fees.

fields.name: market
docs: `sooth_core::Market` account this adjudicator resolves.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority gating `attest_outcome`. MUST be non-default.

fields.name: dispute_authority
docs: Authority gating the `dispute` veto path. Defaults to `authority` at
register time; can be rotated to a guardian multisig via a future ix.

fields.name: attested_outcome
docs: Recorded outcome iff the authority has called `attest_outcome` (or
the `dispute` veto path has overridden it). 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID.

fields.name: attested_at
docs: Unix-seconds timestamp of the original attestation.

fields.name: disputed
docs: One-shot guard: once `dispute` mutates `attested_outcome` this is set
true and subsequent disputes are rejected.

fields.name: disputed_at
docs: Unix-seconds timestamp of the dispute. `None` if not yet disputed.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for the `AdjudicatorEntry` PDA.

types.name: AdjudicatorRegistered
docs: Emitted by `register_adjudicator` when a new per-market `AdjudicatorEntry`
PDA is created. Mirrors EVM `AdjudicatorBase.MarketConfigured`.

fields.name: market
docs: Backlink to `Market` PDA.

fields.name: q_yes
docs: LMSR q_yes — shares outstanding on the YES side.

fields.name: q_no
docs: LMSR q_no — shares outstanding on the NO side.

fields.name: b
docs: LMSR liquidity parameter `b` (positive i128, stored signed).

fields.name: fee_b_base_wad
docs: Accumulated fee WAD for graduation threshold tracking.

fields.name: trial_end_at
docs: Trial window end timestamp (architecture §9).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: CompleteSetMerged
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.Merged` (`OrderEngine.sol:125`).

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC base units returned to user.

types.name: CompleteSetMinted
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.Minted` (`OrderEngine.sol:124`).

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC base units pulled from user.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: Adjudicator pubkey recorded on Market. An `AdjudicatorEntry` PDA must
be created separately via `register_adjudicator`.

types.name: DisputeRaised
docs: Emitted by `dispute` when the `dispute_authority` overrides an attested
outcome. Mirrors EVM `AdjudicatorBase.MarketDisputed`.

types.name: FeesCollected
docs: Mirror of EVM `FeeRouter.FeesDistributed`. Emitted by `distribute_fees`
when the accumulator drains to the four destinations (architecture §8).

fields.name: total_wad
docs: Total fees moved out of `AmmState.fee_b_base_wad` in this call (WAD).

fields.name: to_b_base
docs: Slice routed to the bBase LP-yield ATA.

types.name: FillRecord
docs: One maker fill inside a `buy`. Ticks are recorded as (yes, no) rather than
(taker, maker) so a consumer never has to know which side the taker was on
to price the trade.

fields.name: surplus
docs: Rebate to the taker when yes_tick + no_tick > NUM_TICKS.

fields.name: veto_period_secs
docs: Guardian-veto window in seconds. Use `DEFAULT_VETO_PERIOD_SECS` (24h)
for real deployments; localnet fixtures pass a few seconds so the
resolve → settle → redeem flow is exercisable in one test run.

fields.name: drained_at
docs: Unix seconds when the legacy global fee pool was drained.
`0` means the one-shot drain has not executed.

types.name: LockClaimed
docs: Emitted by `claim_unlocked` after a successful payout. Mirrors the EVM
`LocksProcessed`/`LockEntryRemoved` event family
(`AMMEngine.sol:392-407`).

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC amount locked (net proceeds after sell fee).

fields.name: unlock_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the lock matures and `claim_unlocked` may proceed.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce copied from `Position.lock_nonce` at sell time. Used to derive
the PDA seed so each sell creates a unique LockEntry.

types.name: LpSeeded
docs: Emitted by `seed_lp` after the per-market `LpMint` + creator
`LpPosition` PDA + creator's LP ATA are bootstrapped and seeded
with the initial `lp_amount` allocation.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Deterministic 16-byte id (truncated keccak256 of question || creator
|| nonce). Architecture §2.2.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: The adjudicator pubkey recorded at `initialize_market` time. The
adjudicator is also registered as an `AdjudicatorEntry` PDA. This
field remains the canonical source of truth for the market's
designated adjudicator identity.

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC vault ATA — populated by `initialize_market_vaults`.

fields.name: lock_vault
docs: AMM lock-on-sell escrow vault — populated by `initialize_market_vaults`.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: Set by `settle`. 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID (only meaningful when
lifecycle == Settled).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bumps stored at `initialize_market` time.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: Mirror of EVM `LaunchpadEngine.MarketCreated`. Emitted by `create_market`
after the four instruction legs land (architecture §4.1).

fields.name: initial_b
docs: Initial LMSR liquidity `b` in WAD. Stored on `AmmState` after ix4.

types.name: MarketFeesDistributed
docs: Per-market fee distribution event emitted by `distribute_fees(market)`.

types.name: MarketLocked
docs: Mirror of EVM `TruthMarket.MarketResolved` (LIVE → RESOLVING). Renamed to
"Locked" to match Solana lifecycle names — the semantic intent is the same:
trading halts pending adjudicator outcome. See `state/lifecycle.rs`.

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Mirror of EVM `TruthMarket.MarketSettled` (`TruthMarket.sol:130`).

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID per protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Unfilled amount at the moment of cancellation. An indexer cannot
reconstruct this after the fact: `cancel` zeroes the order in place, so
the size that was withdrawn is gone from state. Ported from main

fields.name: yes_shares
docs: WAD-scaled YES share balance.

fields.name: no_shares
docs: WAD-scaled NO share balance.

types.name: OrdersFilled
docs: All fills from one `buy`, batched into a single event.
Batched deliberately: the P0.1 spike showed per-fill emission OOMs the
32 KB heap. Emitted by `invoke`ing `sooth_log`, not `emit!`/`emit_cpi!` —
see that program's docs for why. Consumers must verify this arrives as a
direct inner instruction of a successful `sooth_core::buy`; `sooth_log`
itself is permissionless.

types.name: OutcomeAttested
docs: Emitted by `attest_outcome` when the per-market authority signs the
resolution. Mirrors EVM `AdjudicatorBase.OutcomeAttested`.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID per protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding.

fields.name: locked_cost_usdc
docs: Cumulative USDC cost paid by this position (used for refund on dismiss).

fields.name: lock_nonce
docs: Per-position nonce used to derive unique `LockEntry` PDAs on each sell.

types.name: PositionSold
docs: Emitted on the sell branch of `trade_positions` after the proceeds have
been moved into the per-sell `LockEntry` PDA. Mirrors the EVM
`ProceedsLocked` event (`AMMEngine.sol:1011-1013`).

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 = NO, 1 = YES.

fields.name: shares_sold
docs: Absolute share count sold (positive). Matches `|delta_shares|`.

fields.name: lock_entry
docs: Lock account that escrows the USDC proceeds. The corresponding
`claim_unlocked` ix takes this pubkey as input.

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC base units escrowed (matches `lock_entry.amount_usdc`).

fields.name: unlock_at
docs: Unix timestamp at which `claim_unlocked` becomes callable.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 = NO, 1 = YES (matches protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding).

fields.name: delta_shares
docs: Signed share delta in WAD. Positive = buy; negative = sell.

fields.name: cost_wad
docs: Signed cost in WAD. Positive = paid; negative = proceeds (sell).

fields.name: ts
docs: Unix timestamp from `Clock`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that may call setters (pause/unpause, future update ixs).

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC ATA where the protocol's slice of every fee distribution lands.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Total per-trade fee in basis points (1 bp = 0.01 %).

fields.name: b_base_share_bps
docs: 4-way fee-destination split bps — must sum to 10_000.

fields.name: default_trial_period
docs: Default trial period in seconds. Architecture §9.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: paused
docs: Circuit-breaker flag. When `true`, `require_not_paused` rejects with
`SoothCoreError::ProtocolPaused`.
Scope is a TRADING halt, not a total freeze — see `require_not_paused`.

fields.name: permissionless_adjudicators
docs: When `true`, anyone can register an adjudicator for any market.
When `false`, only `config.authority` may call `register_adjudicator`.

fields.name: veto_period_secs
docs: Guardian-veto window in seconds. `dispute` is callable while
`now < attested_at + veto_period_secs`; `settle` only after.
Configurable rather than a constant so localnet can run a few seconds
while devnet runs 24h — same binary in both places. A build flag would
have meant the artifact under test was not the artifact deployed.
Zero is legal and means "no veto window": settle becomes callable in
the same slot as attest. That is the old collapsed behaviour, opt-in.

types.name: ProtocolInitialized
docs: Emitted once per protocol deploy by `initialize_protocol`. Indexers can
pin the cluster's authority + treasury without re-reading the PDA.

types.name: ProtocolPausedEvent
docs: Emitted by `pause` and `unpause`. `paused = true` means the protocol was
just paused; `paused = false` means it was just unpaused.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.PositionSettled` (`OrderEngine.sol:430`).
Emitted by `redeem` after a successful post-settlement burn-and-pay.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Resolved outcome at the time of redeem, copied from
`Market::winning_outcome`. 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID.

fields.name: yes_burned
docs: YES outcome-token base units burned (0 if user held none, or if
outcome=NO).

fields.name: no_burned
docs: NO outcome-token base units burned (0 if user held none, or if
outcome=YES).

fields.name: usdc_paid
docs: USDC base units transferred from vault to user.
